requirement: Both axes correspond to authentic source semantics rather than arbitrary reshaping.

Axis-2 position must have a defensible ordering or topology.
Nearby cells/patches must represent meaningfully related source observations.

Labels, attack categories, model outputs, XAI scores, or performance cannot define spatial layout.
